facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland sellers who understand what buyers are actively searching for right now — driven by recent rate cuts — consistently position their home to attract stronger, faster offers in the final weeks of the autumn market
facebook.post_text:
Rate cuts just shifted the buyer pool in East Auckland — are you positioned to benefit? 🏡

Most sellers are still preparing as if nothing has changed. But right now, more qualified buyers are active in East Auckland than at any point this year.

Here's what that means for you:
👉 Buyers who couldn't afford your home six months ago are back in the market
👉 Competition between buyers is rising — which directly protects your final sale price
👉 The sellers capturing this demand are the ones listing now, not in August

The winter slowdown arrives in June. This window is closing faster than most homeowners realise. ⏳

If you're thinking of selling, here's your advantage right now:
✔️ More active buyers means more competing offers on well-presented homes
✔️ Strategic pricing today captures peak autumn demand before it softens
✔️ Listing in the next few weeks puts you ahead of sellers who wait until spring

Are you making the most of this window — or leaving it for someone else to benefit from?
